title: Text area stuck open at fixed height

message.text: Taken: a minion is measuring the text area's height on a real card at three screen sizes to find what props it open. It then makes it hug its content: one line when empty, growing as you talk, capped at about 7 lines. I have not started the assistant-based chunking, as you said. I'll tell you here when it lands.

Checked, and nothing was changed: the box does shrink back after Send. On a real card at 1920 it went from 46px empty to 326px with 12 lines (the cap), then back to 46px after Send. At 800px it went 41, 292, then 41. The box is empty after Send and zero requests failed.
